# Coco Chess Engine

Coco 2.0.0 is a free, open-source C++20 UCI engine for standard chess and
Chess960. It includes the original Ravager v3 NNUE network in each release
executable and supports Lazy SMP and optional Syzygy tablebase files.

- [Downloads](https://github.com/NotKaede-11/Coco-Engine/releases/tag/v2.0.0)
- [Engine source and setup](https://github.com/NotKaede-11/Coco-Engine/tree/v2.0.0)
- [Changelog and local match results](https://github.com/NotKaede-11/Coco-Engine/blob/v2.0.0/CHANGELOG.md#200)
- [Third-party notices](https://github.com/NotKaede-11/Coco-Engine/blob/v2.0.0/third_party/NOTICES.md)

Coco is maintained by NotKaede-11. The embedded Ravager v3 weights and
evaluator are credited to erensh27. Coco is named after the character from
Witch Hat Atelier and is unaffiliated with the series.
